answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Each submission hangs on the cedar of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
